title: Order links no longer add VAT on top
problem: The order-link page added 5% VAT on top of prices that already include VAT.
now: It follows the VAT setup: with prices that include VAT, it shows the VAT inside the total.
steps: Open an order link with VAT on.
The total equals the items plus delivery; VAT shows as included.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
